description: Overview do backend portifolio analytics — ingestao, cliques e permanencia por pagina. Fonte: InfluxDB (measurement page_analytics).

targets.query:
from(bucket: "portifolio_dev")
  |> range(start: -24h)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "page_analytics")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "cliques" or r._field == "visualizacoes" or r._field == "scrolls")
  |> group(columns: ["_field"])
  |> sum()

from(bucket: "portifolio_dev")
  |> range(start: -1h)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "page_analytics" and r._field == "cliques")
  |> aggregateWindow(every: 1m, fn: sum, createEmpty: false)
  |> group(columns: ["page_type"])

from(bucket: "portifolio_dev")
  |> range(start: -24h)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "web_vitals" and r.nome == "LCP" and r._field == "valor")
  |> aggregateWindow(every: 5m, fn: (tables=<-, column) => tables |> quantile(q: 0.75, method: "estimate_tdigest", column: column), createEmpty: false)
  |> group(columns: ["page_type"])

from(bucket: "portifolio_dev")
  |> range(start: -24h)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "custom_events" and r._field == "ocorrencias")
  |> group(columns: ["nome"])
  |> sum()

title: Portifolio Analytics — Overview
